purpose: The ingestion connector catalog. One entry per existing + planned source connector behind the SourceAdapterPort. A connector is the ONLY thing that touches a raw upstream; it emits governed SourceArtifact records (tenant/source/scope/authority/content_hash/handle/lineage/security) and NOTHING served. No connector bypasses the artifact store; tenant_private never updates global_public. status=active connectors have proof_scripts; status=candidate connectors have a deterministic local fallback_fixture + a real adapter behind the same port (never faked truth).
current_impl: scripts/ingest/source_adapters.py (SourceAdapter Protocol + normalize() — the working seam; new typed port home is src/baltor/ports/source_adapter.py)
